title: Density-one higher regularity (Simon 5.7.1, second assertion)
statement: If n >= 1, U is open, V = v(M,theta) has generalized mean curvature H in U, theta is a positive integer mu_V-a.e., H = h mu_V-a.e. for some h that is locally C^{q,alpha} in U (q in N, alpha in (0,1)), xi in U and Theta^n(mu_V, xi) = 1, then there are rho > 0, a linear isometry Q, an open W in R^n containing 0 and u with IsHolderCkα (q+2) alpha u W, u(0) = 0, fderiv u 0 = 0, H^n((Q(M - xi) cap open B_rho(0)) symmetric-difference graph_W u) = 0, and Theta^n(mu_V, x) = 1 for all x in open B_rho(xi) cap spt V.
